# Dayloop v0.12.0-rc13

This candidate makes P5R infiltration guidance and achievement tracking part of the dated completion route.

- Places a compact, pack-themed **Tips** control directly after relevant task text.
- Expands the April 26 Kamoshida strategy into a complete spoiler-friendly boss guide.
- Renames the objective to **Heist: Steal Kamoshida's Heart**.
- Separates Palace and Mementos objectives into an **Infiltration** task section without changing Day/Night progression.
- Reaudits all 53 Royal achievements against the route and displays them on their expected completion dates.
- Automatically derives deterministic achievements from completed tasks while keeping RNG outcomes confirmable.
- Adds explicit route tasks for Arsène, combat trophies, Treasure Demons, Jose exchanges, Showtime, Group Guillotine, and incense training.
